notes: Legacy zero reasoning tokens plus no reasoning text is observed-off, not proof of an explicit off request.
Finance requests reconstructed; historical prompts and providers were not always fully logged.
Retained original providers when known and currently available; otherwise pinned DeepInfra.
No model answer, reference path or gold label is added to request messages.
This is a complementary observational split, not a fully controlled rerun.
concurrency_recovery: Double up to 64 after 30 seconds without a 429 or previous recovery, while pending workers wait.
interruption_note: One authentication startup failed due to operator input error (retained in log). One low-concurrency run was terminated to install recovery; already saved successes are reused, any in-flight unsaved calls may have incurred unreported usage.
provider_policy: Prefer the available original endpoint when healthy and lightly loaded; otherwise balance pinned 0423 providers. Avoid AtlasCloud/DeepInfra/DigitalOcean as first choices based on observed mode mismatch/rate limits. Cooldown a provider for 300 seconds after 429, 3600 seconds after mode mismatch.
